benches.name: native_price61
benches.cmd:
#!/bin/bash
set -o pipefail
v=$HOME/.local/opentallas-tools/verilator-5.050/bin/verilator
p=rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers
q=rtl/hbm_accel/generic/adapters/native_b2/su_quadrant
d=rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/b2
files=($p/ot_hgi_dma_front{,_core12,_ctrl11,_lane12,_xs_vm3,_xsw12}.sv $p/ot_hgi_dma_front_main11.sv $p/ot_hgi_dma_ixpipe.sv $p/ot_hgi_dma_vm_{queue,router9,bank9,transport9}.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv $p/tb_hgi_dma_front_qwen_vm4_12b.sv
$q/ot_hgi_su_ctlw_native_{q,lane2,h}.sv $q/ot_hbm_b2_{lane_cdc,su_vm4}.sv rtl/hbm_accel/service/ot_hbm_accel_cdc_fifo_p2.sv
$d/ot_vms_{bank,hub,rstop,rcl,star,relay,slice}.sv rtl/link/ot_fifo_sram_fwft.sv
physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2/*.v
physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_64x16_m1/*.v
physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2/*.v
physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2/*.v)

mkdir -p {RUN}/bench
"$v" --binary --timing -O2 -Wno-fatal --top-module tb_hgi_dma_front_qwen_vm4_12b -GMUT=0 -GPHASE=61 -GSOURCE_CAP=16 -GREQ_IDLE=0 -Mdir {RUN}/bench/obj_native_price61 "${files[@]}" -j4 >{RUN}/bench/build_native_price61.log 2>&1 && {RUN}/bench/obj_native_price61/Vtb_hgi_dma_front_qwen_vm4_12b +FULL +CHECK_PRICE 2>&1 | tee {RUN}/bench/native_price61.log
